name: P14 battle rules engine — balance pass r3 (bosses that care what level you are, carried walk, join Yes/No)

steps.note: 1. The first fight of the game, Lv 1, Papa and Bobble. One Gloop: Papa leaves it to the lad.
2. Keep walking the Long Lane: EXP, HP and gold carry from fight to fight (Fight! auto-battle).

steps.eval: (() => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { if (__DQ.state().carried.recruitOffer) __DQ.answer(true); __DQ.battle('long_lane', {carry: true}); out.push(__DQ.autoplay(99, 'auto')); } return {fights: __DQ.state().carried.fights, levels: __DQ.state().carried.levels, party: __DQ.state().party}; })()

steps.note: 3. Act II, the Sogglemarsh at its tuned level: an ordinary fight now takes a few rounds and costs something.
4. A monster asks to join: Yes / No, cursor on Yes.

steps.eval: (() => { for (let s = 1; s < 400; s++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.battle('frittering_sands', {level: 10, enemies: [{id: 'cactuddle', partyLevel: 10, areaLevel: 10}], seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'auto'); if (__DQ.state().carried.recruitOffer) { __DQ.instant(false); return s; } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })()

steps.msg: the join offer can be answered Yes / No
the new friend rides in the wagon

steps.note: 5. Three Dune Buggies at the Frittering Sands' tuned level (they used to wipe a fresh party 34% of the time).

steps.eval: (() => { let w = 0, l = 0; for (let s = 1; s <= 40; s++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.battle('frittering_sands', {level: 10, seed: 900 + s, enemies: [0,1,2].map(() => ({id: 'dune_buggy', partyLevel: 10, areaLevel: 10}))}); const r = __DQ.autoplay(99, 'auto'); if (r.outcome === 'victory') w++; else l++; } __DQ.instant(false); return {won: w, lost: l}; })()

steps.note: 6. Bosses at the level children really arrive: Mumbleroot winds up; Bogwallop is still standing in round 3.

steps.eval: (() => { for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.battle.phase !== 'command' || s.battle.enemies.some(e => e.telegraphing)) break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); } return __DQ.state().battle; })()

steps.note: 6b. Levels matter. The Iron Governess at the level children really arrive (24), then four levels under (20), same seed, round 5 of Fight!.

steps.eval: (window.__lv = { governess: __DQ.levels('quiet_quarry', {n: 24, deltas: [-4, 0, 4]}), hoarfax: __DQ.levels('glasswing_grotto', {n: 24, deltas: [-4, 0, 4]}), mortmain: __DQ.levels('quiet_deep', {n: 16, deltas: [-4, 0], fresh: true}) })

steps.msg: Iron Governess: four levels under wins far less often than at the level children arrive
Mortmain: running from everything and arriving four levels under (full HP and MP) struggles

steps.note: 7. The finale for a child who only ever presses Attack, three wipes in (S = 36).

steps.eval: (window.__mm = (() => { let within3 = 0; const n = 24; for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) { let S = 36; for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.assist(S); __DQ.battle('quiet_deep', {boss: true, level: 28, seed: 300 + c * 7 + k}); const r = __DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash'); if (r.outcome === 'victory') { within3++; break; } S = __DQ.state().snapshot.result.assist.after; } } __DQ.instant(false); return {children: n, mortmainAttackOnlyWithin3Tries: within3}; })())

steps.msg: Mortmain: a child who only presses Attack wins within three tries once the rubber band is on

steps.note: 8. Malgrim: Nothing At All, then the moment it gives you — a lullaby. (Find a seed where both happen before the fight ends, then play it round by round.)

steps.eval: (window.__mg = (() => { for (let seed = 4; seed < 160; seed++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.battle('quiet_deep', {boss: 2, level: 28, seed}); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); if (__DQ.log(40).some((t) => t.startsWith('act:listen'))) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase === 'command') { __DQ.instant(false); return seed; } break; } } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })())

steps.msg: a Malgrim fight where Nothing At All is followed by Listen, and the fight goes on

steps.eval: (() => { __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.battle('quiet_deep', {boss: 2, level: 28, seed: window.__mg}); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); if (__DQ.log(40).some((t) => t.startsWith('act:nothing_at_all'))) break; } return __DQ.log(14); })()

(() => { for (let i = 0; i < 4 && !__DQ.log(60).some((t) => t.startsWith('act:listen')); i++) { if (__DQ.state().battle.phase !== 'command') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'auto'); } return __DQ.log(12); })()

steps.msg: the moment after Nothing At All is a lullaby

steps.eval: (() => { for (let s = 1; s < 300; s++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.battle('long_lane_alone', {level: 1, enemies: [{id: 'bumbleblunder', partyLevel: 4}, {id: 'bumbleblunder', partyLevel: 4}], seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash'); if (__DQ.state().battle.phase === 'defeat') { __DQ.instant(false); return s; } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })()
